dispatchPremiseContradicted.claim: Dispatch asserts: 'Zero Cloud Scheduler jobs exist in smartcity-os-prod (checked 2026-09-16) — find its actual trigger mechanism ... before assuming how it starts.'
dispatchPremiseContradicted.liveFinding: FALSE as of 2026-09-17. There are 10 ENABLED Cloud Scheduler jobs in us-central1, all POSTing to the smartcity-scraper Cloud Run service.
dispatchPremiseContradicted.why_it_matters: The mission's step 7 says to cut the scraper over 'by whatever mechanism actually triggers it ... repoint that trigger, not a guess at one.' The trigger is Cloud Scheduler and it is live, so the scraper cutover must repoint 10 scheduler jobs, not stand up a new trigger.
dispatchPremiseContradicted.probableCauseOfBadRecon: The earlier check likely omitted --location. `gcloud scheduler jobs list` REQUIRES a location; there is no 'all locations' wildcard (--location=- errors with INVALID_ARGUMENT).

buildEnvFinding.problem: The smartcity-api Docker build dies with exit 134 at `npm run build:cloud-run`, V8 reporting 'Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit - JavaScript heap out of memory' at roughly 475MB of heap.
buildEnvFinding.deadEnd: Adding a 6GB swapfile does NOT fix it. V8 sizes its old-space limit from the container's VISIBLE MEMORY, not from available swap; swap cannot raise a V8 heap ceiling. Swap was added, the symptom recurred unchanged.
buildEnvFinding.fix: Set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 inline on the RUN line. Build then completed: `vite build` -> '✓ 4030 modules transformed' -> '✓ built in 2m 57s', where it had previously died at 53s.
buildEnvFinding.sideFinding: core.autocrlf=true is set on the Windows checkout, so every file exports CRLF while the committed blobs are LF (git ls-files --eol reports i/lf w/crlf). This matters ONLY for Dockerfile.api, the one file in the context executed by /bin/sh: a `sed -i 's|^RUN npm run build:cloud-run$|...|'` anchor silently failed to match until the CR was stripped, so the patch appeared to apply while doing nothing. Verified with `sed -n '20,24p' | cat -A` showing trailing ^M.

unresolved: smartcity-scraper's trigger must be reproduced on DO. Cloud Scheduler cannot issue an OIDC token for a non-Google endpoint, so the 10 jobs cannot simply be repointed at a DO address without a new authentication story (or exposing the scraper publicly, which it is not today).
